summary: Fixed-width 16-byte struct copy helper. Copies four consecutive dwords (offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0xC) from source pointer a2 to receiver this and returns the copied tail dword as the result. Structural twin of the affine-transform copy cluster (0050c525); no behavior beyond the raw copy is evidenced.

operations.description: Copy the first three dwords (offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8) from source a2 to receiver this.
Read the fourth source dword at offset 0xC, store it into this+0xC and keep it as the return value.
Return the tail dword copied from offset 0xC; this helper is invoked by sub_57BF00 (0057BF00).
